scenarios.name: Art. 5.10 scope executed as spatial blockage

basis.provenanceNote: NC-ET-01 (art. 5.10) applies to new functions that can overload the grid, province-wide and without a GIO; this variant executes the strictest reading as a hard exclusion of the AOI.
NC-ET-03 (art. 5.11) requires an energy paragraph in the plan motivation; this variant documents that the duty is procedural by dropping it — expected delta zero.

basis.rationale: Art. 5.10/5.11 have no provincial zone layer (the marker is province-wide); grid-capacity zones are not a legal designation, so this scenario stays hypothetical — grounded in operator data instead of an arbitrary parameter.
basis.provenanceNote: NOT legally grounded: grounded in netbeheerder congestion data (see dataGrounding); the AOI-wide marker (NC-ET-01) is cited.

dataGrounding.note: voedingsgebied-polygonen Landelijke Capaciteitskaart 'afname' (afname=3: tekort aan transportcapaciteit met wachtrij), Netbeheer Nederland-export

notes: Phase A deterministic sweep (docs/GENAI_SEAMS.md): no LLM at runtime; scenario specs are schema-validated contracts authored by deterministic-scenario-author#poc-v0.
Deltas are measured against the unmutated control re-executed over the baseline run's cached layers (same tunings), not against summary numbers.
Marker semantics (attention/conditional/compensation) never alter the opportunity zone; set_semantics mutations make that policy choice explicit and visible in the delta.
